<br> 

I am currently a fifth-year Ph.D. student in the <a href="https://economics.uchicago.edu" target="_blank"> Kenneth C. Griffin Department of Economics</a> at the University of Chicago. My research interests are in labor economics and applied macroeconomics.

Prior to my doctoral studies, I worked at <a href="https://www.cornerstone.com" target="_blank"> Cornerstone Research</a>. I completed my undergraduate degree at the University of Chicago with a double major in economics and mathematics.

In my free time, I enjoy performing as a <a href="https://www.rockefeller.uchicago.edu/carillon-recitals-and-tower-tours/" target="_blank"> student Carillonist at Rockefeller Memorial Chapel</a>, exploring Chicago's dining scene, and taking photos of sunsets.
